Class SqlGameDAO

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.persistence.SqlGameDAO
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameDAO
public class SqlGameDAO extends Object implements GameDAO
MySQL implementation of GameDAO.

Uses a ConnectionProvider to obtain connections so that the data source can be swapped in tests. saveMatch(int, int, List, List) runs inside a transaction and rolls back automatically on failure. getLeaderboard(int) computes a dense rank client-side (cumulative scores per player, ordered descending).

    • saveMatch

      public void saveMatch(int gameId, int playerCount, List<String> nicknames, List<Integer> scores) throws SQLException
      Finalises a match: stamps matches with the current timestamp and player count, then upserts each player into players and inserts their score into results. Called once when the game ends. The whole operation runs in a single transaction and is rolled back if any step fails.
      Specified by:
      saveMatch in interface GameDAO
      Parameters:
      gameId - the match ID created by createMatch()
      playerCount - number of players who participated
      nicknames - player nicknames, in the same order as scores
      scores - final prestige-point totals, in the same order as nicknames
      Throws:
      SQLException - if any step fails; the transaction is rolled back first
